# SHAHED IT

> SHAHED IT is a Rajshahi, Bangladesh-based digital agency providing web development, design, digital marketing, and IT services with transparent BDT pricing and 24/7 support.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of SHAHED IT and featured services.
- [About](/about): Company background, values, and team.
- [Services](/services): Full list of digital and IT services offered.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Service plans and transparent BDT pricing.
- [Portfolio](/portfolio): Selected client projects and case studies.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles on web, design, marketing, and IT.
- [FAQ](/faq): Common questions about services, payments, and support.
- [Careers](/careers): Open roles at SHAHED IT.
- [Contact](/contact): Phone, email, and office address.
- [Get a Quote](/get-quote): Request a custom project quote.
